# reader

The docs surface — a sanitized markdown reader for a session's plan and the .md files under its directory, with a file nav, outline and pop-out.

- Spec: `docs/features/reader/spec.md`
- Contract: `docs/features/reader/contract.md`

## Files

```
go: internal/claudecode/plan*.go
go: internal/claudecode/files*.go
go: internal/server/reader*.go
go: internal/session/reader_test.go
go: internal/store/migrations/0008_reader.sql
web: web/src/reader/**
web: web/src/features/reader.ts
web: web/src/render/reader.ts
web: web/src/doc.ts
web: web/doc.html
e2e: web/e2e/reader.spec.ts
e2e: web/e2e/helpers/reader.ts
```

## Protocol

- `sessions.reader` — `GET /api/sessions/{id}/reader`
- `sessions.reader-file` — `GET /api/sessions/{id}/reader/file`
- `ws.doc-changed` — `docChanged`
- `ws.session` — The Session object

## Decisions

- `kb:adr/reader-change-signal-is-the-write-hook` — A routed Write, Edit or MultiEdit hook naming a markdown file becomes a docChanged message; freshness is the hook time and absent when no write was seen. (accepted, 2026-09-14; features: reader, ingest) → `docs/adr/reader-change-signal-is-the-write-hook.md`
- `kb:adr/reader-docs-is-third-surface-segment` — The reader is a third docs kind in the claude | shell segment, replacing the pane, with a right-hand file nav; drawer, split and window-only were rejected. (accepted, 2026-09-14; features: reader, surfaces) → `docs/adr/reader-docs-is-third-surface-segment.md`
- `kb:adr/reader-markdown-rendered-in-browser` — Markdown is rendered in the browser with marked and DOMPurify pinned exactly; the daemon hands raw text/markdown bytes and trusts nothing it serves. (accepted, 2026-09-14; features: reader) → `docs/adr/reader-markdown-rendered-in-browser.md`
- `kb:adr/reader-memory-split-browser-and-daemon` — Last open file and cleared change dots are browser memory per session; which files Claude wrote is daemon memory lost on restart; nothing goes to SQLite. (accepted, 2026-09-14; features: reader) → `docs/adr/reader-memory-split-browser-and-daemon.md`
- `kb:adr/reader-nav-sections-shrink-without-floor` — The nav's tree and outline shrink proportionally with no minimum height; a one-row tree in a dense tile is accepted because both sections stay scrollable. (accepted, 2026-09-14; features: reader) → `docs/adr/reader-nav-sections-shrink-without-floor.md`
- `kb:adr/reader-plan-located-by-transcript-scan` — The plan path is derived by scanning the transcript every hook names, on bounded triggers, and persisted on the session row; no watcher, no poll. (accepted, 2026-09-14; features: reader, lifecycle, ingest) → `docs/adr/reader-plan-located-by-transcript-scan.md`
- `kb:adr/reader-popout-is-a-second-page` — The pop-out is a second Vite page with its own composition root sharing the reader component and socket client; a hash route in the dashboard was rejected. (accepted, 2026-09-14; features: reader) → `docs/adr/reader-popout-is-a-second-page.md`
- `kb:adr/reader-served-paths-confined-to-directory-or-plan` — The file route serves only a resolved path under the resolved session directory ending in .md, or the resolved plan path; anything else is 404, nothing writes. (accepted, 2026-09-14; features: reader) → `docs/adr/reader-served-paths-confined-to-directory-or-plan.md`
